key_findings: Official hnswlib neighbor selection does not refill from discarded candidates; Strict RNG matches official hnswlib exactly.
Under exact matched budget (B0=1.6M on SIFT-100K, B0=8.0M on SIFT-500K), Normalized Exponential Allocation outperforms uniform allocation.
On SIFT-500K, Normalized Exponential Allocation achieves +15.4% throughput speedup and -42% P95 latency reduction.
Randomized and Reversed Geometry controls confirm that routing performance is driven by geometric alignment rather than degree variance.
